verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list remote view and control, so input from the viewer does reach the host. A heavy daily user confirms it works well, with no NumLock bug, but reports alt-tab problems from Linux to Windows 10. That keystroke-handling gap is a documented limitation, not a contradiction of the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mouse, keyboard and scroll are injected as native OS events, scroll-input evidence, and reliable handling of system shortcuts like alt-tab across platforms.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events

citations.quote: Remote view and control, unattended access with a permanent password
It has no NumLock bug and can play YouTube where AnyDesk chugs. However, alt-tab has issues from Linux to Windows 10
